purpose: Exploratory offline YOLO window plus VisionState WheelReader feasibility trial; never production meter or invoice input.

referencePolicy.author: Codex independent visual-review agent
referencePolicy.source: Visual inspection of original project-local images only; no prior OCR/Vision predictions or previous readings used for labels.
limitations: Five reused exploratory photographs are not a held-out accuracy benchmark or representative sample.
Visible references are agent annotations, not independently verified meter readings or billing truth.
A question mark denotes an unresolved wheel. Exact full-row scoring must exclude samples with exactDigits=null.
Manual crop geometry and digit/decimal counts are baseline configuration, not detector predictions; automatic and manual paths must be reported separately.
Decimals and units are configured from visible markings/colour groups for this trial; WheelReader does not infer them.
Preserve original photo hashes and do not revise a label or crop after seeing trial predictions without declaring a new exploratory variant.

geometry.space: Original image pixels after EXIF transpose; all five source files have EXIF orientation 1.
geometry.box: [left, top, right, bottom] axis-aligned bounding box containing the manual row quadrilateral.
geometry.corners: Four manually chosen source points mapping to rectified [top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left] in reading order. The weathered source row is vertical and the corner order rectifies it counter-clockwise.
geometry.provenance: Approximate original-image visual annotation, locked before model predictions; not finely optimized crops.

reference.boundaryEvidence: Five black wheels followed by one red wheel; printed weights end at 1 and 1/10; kWh is printed beside the register.
reference.quality: Readable row, mild tilt; original photo rather than a calibrated camera frame.

reference.boundaryEvidence: Printed weights show five black integer places and a red 1/10 place. The small red wheel is unresolved in the original image.
reference.quality: Very small native row; no exact label assigned to the red wheel. Score integer prefix only, never treat model output as the missing reference.

samples.sourceKind: Existing sample named screenshot; visually an opened mechanical electric meter photograph.

reference.boundaryEvidence: The printed place weights run from 10000 to 1 then 1/10; kWh is visible. Last wheel shows split/transition-like strokes and is left unresolved.
reference.quality: Small counter row and ambiguous rightmost wheel; full-row accuracy cannot be assessed from this annotation.

reference.boundaryEvidence: Five black wheels followed by three red wheels beside m3; downstream dial is marked x0.0001. Decimal placement is an explicit trial configuration.
reference.quality: Readable black and red wheels with noticeable diagonal row and perspective. Intermediate wheel geometry must remain observable.

reference.boundaryEvidence: Four dark integer wheels followed by one red wheel; lower-place pointer dials carry x0.01/x0.001/x0.0001 markings. m3 unit is beside the register.
reference.quality: Worn/dirty glass and source rotated roughly 90 degrees. Reference is a provisional visual annotation; user has not confirmed the observed reading.
